subject: general
question: Neeruswamy Pillai and Rajaratanam Pillai are exponents of which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nadaswaran**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeruswamy Pillai and Rajaratanam Pillai **are **notable exponents**.
 
• They **specialize** in **playing the Nadaswaram**.
 
• The **Nadaswaram **is a traditional **wind instrument**.
 
• It is prominent in **South Indian classical music**.
 
• **Both Pillais **have made significant **contributions to the art form**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mandolin**

 
 
• **Stringed musical instrument.**
 
• Member of the **lute family**.
 
• Commonly used in **classical, folk, bluegrass, and country music**.
 
 
 
• **Mridangam** 
 
 
• **Traditional South Indian percussion instrument**.
 
• **Double-headed drum **made of** wood**.
 
• Integral in **Carnatic music **concerts and **classical dance performances**.
 
 
 
• **Sarangi**
 
 
• Traditional **bowed string instrument** from the** Indian subcontinent**.
 
• Known for its **expressive and melodic capabilities**.
 
• Used in c**lassical, folk, and devotional music**.
